warning: SYNTHETIC DATA REGISTER. Records provenance and visibility of every generated dataset. Not Zava North Homes data.
rules: Every dataset has a visibility of public or private and a data_dictionary pointer.
Public datasets are committed under docs/ or an evals folder (src/<project>/evals) and carry is_synthetic=true on every record or an explicit exemption.
Private datasets stay under restricted support/ or the per-user ZF_DATA folder outside the repository; src/**/data is ignored as a defensive rule, not an approved output destination (ADR 0006).
Real map addresses are anchors only, not evidence about a real household. Runtime chat and tenant bindings can contain personal data and are outside the synthetic-fixture guarantee.
Generated status is independent of visibility: a tested generator does not establish materialization of the full-stock dataset.
The offline source audit rejects missing retrieval dates and provisional licence/attribution wording; nulls below are unresolved evidence, not successful provenance.
